title: Iran Is Emboldened After Trump and GOP’s Election Losses, Officials Say
partialText: Iran’s negotiating position has hardened since the midterms, U.S. and other Western officials say. An American lawmaker warned that Iran felt “strategically empowered.”

title: A.I. Helps Find Major Security Bug in Java, a Software Platform Vital to the Internet
partialText: The discovery by security company Calif shows A.I.’s ability to find gaping security holes in popular software. The Java flaw pointed to vulnerabilities in systems used by nearly all Fortune 500 companies.

title: Classified N.S.A. Network Goes Down, Causing Work Disruptions
partialText: There are currently no signs that the outage is the result of a cyberattack or other nefarious activity, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Apple Addresses Outages Affecting Apple Pay, iCloud and Apps
partialText: The disruption followed days of unrelated problems in the past week that interrupted air travel and work at offices, schools and government.

title: U.S. Loses Its Measles Elimination Status, a Historic Setback for American Health
partialText: The nation was once regarded as a global leader for reining in the highly contagious virus. Now, large outbreaks that sicken thousands could become routine.

title: Measles Is Officially Back in the United States. What Now?
partialText: It may take years for the country to regain elimination status. In the meantime, communities will need to adopt numerous strategies to protect people.

title: Do You Need a Measles Booster?
partialText: As cases spread across North America, now is a good time to check your vaccination status.

title: President Trump Starts Asia Trip in Manila by Shrugging Off U.S. Concerns
partialText: Even for a president who prizes photo opportunities, Mr. Trump’s appearance in Manila suggested a lack of interest in diplomatic wins or issues at home. “It’s life,” he said.

title: Trump’s New A.I. Chip Rules Rattle Southeast Asia
partialText: New U.S. restrictions could jeopardize billions in investment and force countries in the region to strike an increasingly difficult balance between Washington and Beijing.

title: Schools Are Closing Nationwide as Enrollment Drops. Parents Are Livid.
partialText: With fewer babies being born and more school choice, districts across the country have concluded they must downsize. Families are trying to push back.

title: Enrollment in N.Y.C. Schools Falls by 23,000
partialText: New York City has lost 200,000 students over the past decade, mirroring declines in districts across the United States.

title: Does This Man Have a Right to the Data From His Own Brain?
partialText: J. Galen Buckwalter cheerfully agreed to provide his neural data for a research study. But when he asked for a copy, things got complicated.

title: With House Democratic Majority Still Growing, Recounts Are Starting in Closest Races
partialText: The exact size of the Democratic majority in Congress was undetermined as recounts were sought in two races in North Carolina and one in Minnesota two weeks after the elections.

title: I.R.S. Opens Criminal Probes as Part of Trump’s Pursuit of Left-Wing Groups
partialText: An internal I.R.S. memo viewed by The New York Times reveals how the agency is carrying out President Trump’s orders to investigate “domestic terrorism.”

title: Hegseth Nominates His Former Aide to Lead the Army
partialText: After months of delay, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and the White House have sent Gen. Christopher LaNeve’s nomination for Army chief of staff to the Senate.

title: Another Storm Is Bearing Down on California
partialText: This week will bring wind gusts up to 70 miles per hour, buckets of rain and some of the first heavy snow of the season, forecasters said.

title: Shock and Dread in the Gulf
partialText: Gulf countries talk about the consequences of a war against Iran not of their making.

title: The Winning Democrat Who Wants to Break Up Political Parties
partialText: Iowa’s governor-elect, Rob Sand, ran on a platform criticizing the two-party system. How will he translate his campaign message into reform?

title: Kevin Bleyer, Writer Behind Obama’s Speech Roasting Trump, Has Died at 54
partialText: The Emmy Award-winning writer worked with Jon Stewart, Bill Maher and Barack Obama, and may just have helped motivate Donald Trump to run for office.
